about: Bedouin cushions for the home page's menu (drawn, transparent webp, up to 420px wide). Each menu item takes one; the free ones are kept for items added later. In public/index.html: { pillow: 'pNN', c2: '<the colour its letters glow in>' }.

orange-red kilim, wide, zigzags round a blue diamond
black tatreez, square, a red star, tassels
red kilim, square, a blue diamond on cream
white tatreez, a purple star, red flowers
red-orange kilim, long, stripes and a diamond
red kilim, long, an orange diamond
a pair: a deer and a diamond, sand colours
